This can create a high-cost primitive-placeholder/construction-causality deduction in hero/oblique framing.

manufactureInstallationReasoning.mountingAndInterfaces: The path begins exactly at the ParkPath east edge, sits 3 mm below paving, passes through whole-module curb opening 26/27, bears on verge subgrade, then curves and tapers northeast. Shoulders feather within roughly 3 mm of turf grade instead of exposing a vertical soil-slab side.
manufactureInstallationReasoning.orientationExposure: Upward exterior ground; midsummer sun/rain/drying plus concentrated pedestrian traffic at the access opening.
manufactureInstallationReasoning.aging: Cause-based footfall compaction and small long-wave settlement, reduced use toward the terminal, UV drying and turf encroachment at shoulders. No arbitrary story-driven damage.
manufactureInstallationReasoning.geometryVsMaterial: Curve, width evolution, wearing-course level, curb opening, shoulder feather, center depression and terminal taper are geometry. Grains/fines, roughness, restrained albedo variation and angular dielectric response remain material/microdetail.

materialContract.family: dry compacted pedestrian soil/fines with small gravel
materialContract.uvPolicy: UV0 stores world X/Z metres; material tiling is reciprocal physical tile size; emission and baked directional highlights are forbidden.

selfAudit.initialRejectedImplementation: The first spline used P1=(12.15,5.40) and expanded route width immediately. Source-math review found 11 inverted/folded triangles at the high-curvature mouth, including triangle-normal Y near -1. That version was rejected rather than hidden by material/culling changes.
selfAudit.correction: P1 moved to (12.45,5.40); mouth width remains fixed at 1.05 m through normalized t=0.22, expands only over t=0.22-0.55, holds to t=0.68, then tapers. Triangle winding was corrected to upward ground orientation and all LOD meshes now run an explicit upward-normal QA after RecalculateNormals.
